cases.title: Planted time-of-day effect claimed as a condition effect (times unknown)
cases.claim: PLANTED TIME, times unknown: SQSTM1 up in CD14+ monocytes, afternoon group B vs morning group A (Kang)
cases.how_built: All cells. The 8 donors were split (seed 0) into fake groups A = patient_1016, patient_1039, patient_107, patient_1256 (collected 08:00-12:00) and B = patient_101, patient_1015, patient_1244, patient_1488 (13:00-18:00), 4 vs 4. Each donor is one sample: its ctrl and stim cells are pooled (they were processed together and share one collection time), so the analysis has 8 units, not 16. Counts of 13 core clock genes and of SQSTM1 (higher by night in 6 of 6 GTEx tissues, Wucher 2023) were multiplied per donor by 2^(a cos(2π(t - peak)/24)) with the documented peaks and half-amplitudes (0.2-0.7 log2) and Poisson-resampled, so the only difference between A and B is a time-of-day effect. IFN-beta status is balanced within every donor and cannot confound the fake groups.
cases.expected: label before the time check ROBUST; time check POSSIBLE TIME CONFOUND; final verdict not ROBUST
cases.rule: label_before_time_check is ROBUST (the replicate-aware analysis called the planted effect) AND the time-check label is POSSIBLE TIME CONFOUND AND the final verdict is not ROBUST

cases.how_built: A random 40% of cells (seed 0) were assigned to 'batch2'; in those cells 300 random expressed genes were multiplied by 2.5 and 300 others divided by 2.5 (rounded). cases.expected: not ROBUST; holds only when batch correction is off
cases.rule: verdict is not ROBUST AND every run in which the claim held had batch_correction=off
